name: Koh Young Technology Inc.
summary: Koh Young Technology Inc. engages in the manufacturing and sale of automated inspection and precise measurement systems and equipment in South Korea and internationally. The company's products portfolio comprises solder paste, automated optical, semiconductor, dispensing process, and final optical inspection equipment; smart factory solutions comprising KSMART solution, a 3D measurement-based process control system; KPO printers, an AI-based automatic printing process optimizer; and KPO mounters, an AI-based automatic mounting process optimizer; and medical robots.
